name: Payment History
query: select pe.name as "Payment Entry:Link/Payment Entry:180", pe.posting_date as "Posting Date:Date:120", pe.party as "Customer:Link/Customer:180", t.name as "Tenant:Link/Tenant:180", pe.paid_amount as "Paid Amount:Currency:140", pe.received_amount as "Received Amount:Currency:140", pe.reference_no as "Reference No:Data:140", pe.docstatus as "Docstatus:Int:90" from `tabPayment Entry` pe left join `tabTenant` t on t.customer = pe.party where pe.party_type = 'Customer' order by pe.posting_date desc, pe.modified desc
